title: Layout styling
description: Shared per-block box-model controls (.ai/block-card-appearance-plan.md in qcg-frontend-next) — distinct from a block's own visual-variant content field, if it has one (e.g. banner_images' displayStyle).

appearance.description: Card (inset margin/border/shadow) or plain (full-width within the 480px frame). Omitted defers to the specific block's own default.

transparent.description: Force a fully see-through background, overriding any resolved surface colour. Default false (opaque).

fullWidth.description: Break the block out of the 480px mobile frame entirely, spanning the physical viewport. A distinct axis from appearance — this leaves the frame, appearance never does.
